描述_EN: fragment of monochrome tapestry square. it must have been a galloping rider whose course was followed by his dog. We can make out the rear of a horse (hind legs, rump and tail), topped by a stole (?), probably the cape or wide scarf of the now-defunct rider, and a small animal facing the other way to the right. a wide frame is composed of a stylized vine scroll forming medallions alternately occupied by vine leaves and animals (lions, hares, etc.). the central scene is set within a circle inscribed in a square.
描述_ZN: 单色挂毯方形的碎片。 它一定是一个飞奔的骑手，他的路线由他的狗跟随。 我们可以看到一匹马的后部（后腿、臀部和尾巴），上面有一个披肩（？），可能是现在已经不存在的骑手的斗篷或宽围巾，还有一个小动物朝向右边的另一边。 一个宽大的框架由风格化的藤蔓卷轴组成，形成了由藤叶和动物（狮子、野兔等）交替占据的勋章。 中心场景设置在一个刻有方形的圆内。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
